name: Debit Authorisation Confirmation 3
definition: Specifies whether or not the debit authorisation is granted.

DebitAuthorisation.name: Debit Authorisation
DebitAuthorisation.definition: Code expressing the decision taken by the account owner relative to the request for debit authorisation.

AmountToDebit.name: Amount To Debit
AmountToDebit.definition: Amount of money authorised for debit. |Usage: The party approving the debit may want to authorise the amount less charges and may only be prepared to approve the debit for value today rather than the original value date.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account to which debit should be booked.

ValueDateToDebit.name: Value Date To Debit
ValueDateToDebit.definition: Value date for debiting the account.

CommonTransactionIdentification.name: Common Transaction Identification
CommonTransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification (UTI) agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.||Usage: Only used by the Securities industry.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the debit authorisation response.
